column3: RTL derivation: requirement is AxiXbar to AxiCrossbar plus u_xbar to u_crossbar with file/module agreement; AXI valid-ready rules, ports, parameters, FSM/register topology, reset, owner lifetime, critical paths, and synthesis logic are unchanged. Protocol-standard CLINT/PLIC/UART/DPI/virtio-blk names remain. Historical test/log markers stay verbatim. The expected normalized pre-edit crossbar SHA-256 is d86044c4a929e49d9d264aa3da1331d71b4ce302e1f28688f3fc704888a35103.
Legacy production module AxiXbar was rejected by check-rtl-style before rename; full current synth closure passes after AxiCrossbar migration.
Rename only the retired Xbar identifier family. Preserve AXI4-Lite and protocol-standard CLINT/PLIC/UART/DPI/virtio names, so the naming gate does not constrain valid hardware vocabulary.
The exact old-source module-token normalization hashes to the new AxiCrossbar source; ports, parameters, owner state, data path and cycle contract are unchanged.

Keep historical tb_axi_xbar names, IFU-AXI-G1-XBAR markers and RTL_AXI_XBAR mutation override as evidence compatibility keys; production filelist and hierarchy use only RTL_AXI_CROSSBAR/AxiCrossbar/u_crossbar.

Stored IFU evidence remains bound to the former raw source path and therefore reports stale after the identifier migration. It was not rewritten; current focused simulation and elaboration are retained separately.
Independent review found the broad Xbar substring rule would reject legal L2XbarAdapter; the executable self-test now rejects only exact AxiXbar and accepts that legal counterexample.

Independent review false-green resolved by retaining former PASS payloads byte-for-byte in task-run history and publishing explicit GAP tombstones at both active IFU current evidence paths; full architecture remains GAP and PPA unqualified.
